required_documents.name: Application for Federal Assistance SF-424
required_documents.details: Standard cover application submitted through Grants.gov.

required_documents.name: Project Narrative
required_documents.details: Technical project description detailing project goals, implementation strategy, and community impact.

required_documents.name: Budget Justification Narrative
required_documents.details: Itemized cost computation explaining all proposed expenditures.

eligibility.summary: Each organization submitting an application must qualify at the time of the award as a small business concern as defined by the Small Business Administration. Foreign entities are not eligible to compete for, or receive, awards made under this announcement. In North Carolina, eligible entities fitting the organizational requirements may apply.

cost_share.details: No cost sharing or non-federal matching funds are required.

review_criteria.criterion: Work Plan Feasibility and Milestone Schedule

submission_limits: Applicant organizations may submit more than one proposal, provided each proposal is scientifically distinct.
important_notes: Forecasted Opportunity: This is an advance forecast notice. Official application packages and final closing dates will be released upon posting.
Application submission is administered via Grants.gov or the designated federal portal for opportunity HHS-2027-ACL-NIDILRR-BISA-0308.
SAM.gov registration must be active with valid Unique Entity Identifier (UEI) prior to submission; allow 3-4 weeks for new registrations.
Review all instructions, eligibility requirements, and deadlines published on Grants.gov before preparing submission.
